title: Pre-alpha trailer for my hockey video game (300+ hours of dev time)
author: Cheeeeese1313
selftext:
Still got a lot of work to do, but I’m very proud of the current state of the game. Gladly open to feedback and any questions on my development process using Claude and various tools I used. 

Some info on the process. I’d say over 50% of the sounds in the game I’ve recorded myself at a local ice rink. The animations for all the players, goalies, etc., was by far the hardest part and took probably a quarter of the dev time and a lot of manual tinkering to get right with Claude x Blender MCP. Had to show it lots and lots of hockey clips to get shooting and puck handling animations right. Not mention that endless hours I spent in practice mode. 

For CPU logic, I linked it to the used the NHLs public stats API to ingest all of that data to really make it so the players play like real hockey players. 

Even though I use Claude did the heavy lifting this took 300+ hours of going back and forth over every single detail to get the nuances of hockey right  

Fable 5.2 was a huge help, especially with some of the more stubborn animations and clipping with the player models
